directive.quote: finish the film repository port so the repo can be retired: settings are rows in the person's lists, read through the door

preserve: The BLAKE3 identity of the exact ordered ffmpeg arguments and each input's bytes
The sidecar serialization and the requirement that current input bytes match before reuse
Bounded chunked reads for any input whose exact digest is not already stable in this render
allowed_deltas: Reuse a digest only within one render session, with a fixed entry bound and exact file-version checks on the opened descriptor and path before and after lookup
Use dev, inode, size, nanosecond mtime and ctime only to validate a cached exact BLAKE3 digest, never as a substitute identity
banned_substitutions: Using file metadata in place of the BLAKE3 of exact bytes
An unbounded, global or cross-render digest cache
Changing argument ordering, input bindings or sidecar identity serialization
